THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
TEXTURE IN MOTION
054
75 / Caramel Coat
Tawny Shag
A long, caramel-brown shaggy knit coat with an oversized shawl
collar worn open over a suede-look brown mini dress with a
gold-sequin trim at the neckline and hem. Cream ribbed socks
and black lace-up boots with buckles complete the look against a
warm wood-panel wall.
76 / Smocked Denim
Blue on Blue
A crouched, low pose in an off-the-shoulder smocked top with
ruffled edges and a matching denim-look mini skirt, paired with
black mesh Mary Jane flats. Long dark hair falls past the
shoulders, with one hand resting near the chin against a deep
blue backdrop.
